('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'small', 'r0-r7').source:
IN R0           ; R0 = n

    ; Handle base cases
    JZ R0, ZERO     ; if n == 0, output 0
    MOV R1, 1
    JZ R1, ONE      ; never, but placeholder
    ; Check if n == 1
    MOV R2, 1
    SUB R2, R0      ; R2 = 1 - n
    JZ R2, ONE      ; if n == 1, output 1

    ; General case: compute fib(n)
    ; R1 = fib(i-1) = fib(0) = 0
    ; R2 = fib(i)   = fib(1) = 1
    ; R3 = counter, starts at 1, goes up to n-1
    ; R4 = modulus
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R4, 1000000007

LOOP:
    ; Check if R3 >= R0 (i.e., we've done n-1 iterations)
    JGE R3, R0, DONE

    ; R5 = R1 + R2
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R4

    ; shift: R1 = R2, R2 = R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

    INC R3
    JMP LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R2
    HALT

ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'medium', 'r0-r7').source:
; Fibonacci using a "two-steps-at-a-time" loop structure
; with a different register layout than previous solutions.
; R0 = n (input)
; R6 = modulus = 10^9+7
; We keep three consecutive fib values: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
; and advance by 2 each iteration, handling odd/even n separately.

    IN R0
    MOV R6, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, BASE_ZERO

    MOV R4, 1
    JLE R0, R4, BASE_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, f(2)=1
    ; R1 = f(k-1), R2 = f(k), R3 = f(k+1)
    ; Start at k=1: R1=f(0)=0, R2=f(1)=1, R3=f(2)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1

    ; R5 = remaining steps from index 1 to n (we need n-1 more steps)
    ; We'll track current index in R4, start at 2 (we've computed up to f(2))
    MOV R4, 2

LOOP2:
    ; If R4 >= R0, we're done
    JGE R4, R0, DONE

    ; Advance by 2: compute f(k+2) and f(k+3) from f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)
    ; But first check if one more step suffices
    MOV R5, R4
    ADD R5, 1
    JGE R5, R0, ONE_MORE

    ; Two steps:
    ; f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1)  -- R3 already is f(k+1), R2=f(k-1)... wait
    ; Let me restate: after each iteration, R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
    ; Step 1: new values: f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)=f(k)+f(k+1)
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R6
    ; Now R1=f(k-1)->discard, R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R7=f(k+2)
    ; Step 2: f(k+1), f(k+2), f(k+3)=f(k+1)+f(k+2)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R7
    MOD R1, R6
    ; Shift: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)... wait need to reassign
    ; R_new1 = R3 (f(k+1)), R_new2 = R7 (f(k+2)), R_new3 = R1 (f(k+3))
    ; Use temp: R1 currently holds f(k+3)
    ; We need: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)
    MOV R5, R1      ; R5 = f(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3      ; R1 = f(k+1)
    MOV R2, R7      ; R2 = f(k+2)
    MOV R3, R5      ; R3 = f(k+3)
    ADD R4, 2
    JMP LOOP2

ONE_MORE:
    ; One step: compute f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1) -- but R3=f(k+1), R2=f(k)
    ; Actually current state: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R4=k+1
    ; We need f(R4+1) = f(k+1) + f(k+2)? No.
    ; Current index is R4 meaning we have f(R4) = R3
    ; We need f(R4+1) = R2 + R3... wait
    ; R4 is the index of R3. So f(R4) = R3, f(R4-1) = R2.
    ; f(R4+1) = R2 + R3
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    MOD R5, R6
    OUT R5
    HALT

DONE:
    ; R4 == R0, answer is R3 = f(R4) = f(n)
    OUT R3
    HALT

BASE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

BASE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(n)', 'medium', 'r0-r7').source:
IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R6, 1000000007  ; modulus

    ; Store fib values in memory: mem[i] = fib(i)
    ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R1, 0
    STOR R1, [R1+0]     ; mem[0] = 0

    ; If n == 0, done
    JZ R0, OUTPUT

    ; mem[1] = 1
    MOV R2, 1
    STOR R2, [R2+0]     ; mem[1] = 1

    ; If n == 1, done
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R0, R3, OUTPUT

    ; Fill mem[2..n] using mem[i] = mem[i-1] + mem[i-2]
    ; R4 = current index i, starts at 2
    MOV R4, 2

FILL:
    JGT R4, R0, OUTPUT  ; if i > n, stop

    ; Load mem[i-1] and mem[i-2]
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 1
    LOAD R2, [R5+0]     ; R2 = mem[i-1]

    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 2
    LOAD R1, [R5+0]     ; R1 = mem[i-2]

    ; Compute fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R6

    ; Store mem[i] = R3
    STOR R3, [R4+0]

    INC R4
    JMP FILL

OUTPUT:
    ; Load mem[n] and output
    LOAD R5, [R0+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'large', 'r0-r7').source:
; Fibonacci: compute fib(n) mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: unroll loop by 4 - process 4 steps per iteration
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = fib(k)   (current)
; R2 = fib(k+1)
; R3 = fib(k+2)
; R4 = fib(k+3)
; R5 = modulus
; R6 = index tracker (how many fibs computed beyond fib(1))
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R5, 1000000007

    JZ R0, DONE_ZERO

    MOV R7, 1
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE

    MOV R7, 2
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE   ; fib(2) = 1

    ; n >= 3
    ; Start with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1, fib(3)=2
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R4, R7             ; R4 = fib(3) = 2

    ; R6 = current highest index computed = 3
    MOV R6, 3

    ; Check if n <= 3
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT

LOOP4:
    ; We have fib(k), fib(k+1), fib(k+2), fib(k+3) in R1,R2,R3,R4
    ; Check if we can do 4 more steps (need index+4 <= n)
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 4
    JGT R7, R0, REMAINDER

    ; Step 1: fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R4
    MOD R1, R5

    ; Step 2: fib(k+5) = fib(k+3) + fib(k+4)
    MOV R2, R4
    ADD R2, R1
    MOD R2, R5

    ; Step 3: fib(k+6) = fib(k+4) + fib(k+5)
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R5

    ; Step 4: fib(k+7) = fib(k+5) + fib(k+6)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, R3
    MOD R4, R5

    ADD R6, 4
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    JMP LOOP4

REMAINDER:
    ; Do one step at a time until R6 == n
    ; Current state: R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; R6 = k+3

STEP1:
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    ; fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R7, R3
    ADD R7, R4
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R3
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R7
    INC R6
    JMP STEP1

PICK_RESULT:
    ; R6 = highest index, R0 = n
    ; R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; where k = R6-3
    ; Determine which register holds fib(n)
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, 3
    ; if n == R7 => fib(n) = R1
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    ; R7 = R6 - n: 0=>R4, 1=>R3, 2=>R2, 3=>R1
    JZ R7, OUT_R4
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 1
    JZ R7, OUT_R3
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 2
    JZ R7, OUT_R2
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_R4:
    OUT R4
    HALT

OUT_R3:
    OUT R3
    HALT

OUT_R2:
    OUT R2
    HALT

DONE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

DONE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(log n)', 'medium', 'r0-r.source:
; Fibonacci using matrix exponentiation (iterative doubling method)
; fib(2k)   = fib(k) * (2*fib(k+1) - fib(k))
; fib(2k+1) = fib(k)^2 + fib(k+1)^2
; This is O(log n) time, fundamentally different from all iterative O(n) solutions above.
;
; We store the "stack" of bits of n in memory, then process from MSB to LSB.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = temp / bit storage pointer
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Store bits of n (LSB first) in mem[0], mem[1], ...
    ; We'll read them back MSB first
    MOV R4, 0          ; bit count / index
    MOV R7, R0         ; working copy of n

BIT_EXTRACT:
    JZ R7, BITS_DONE
    ; bit = R7 % 2
    MOV R5, R7
    MOD R5, 2
    STOR R5, [R4+0]    ; store bit
    INC R4
    DIV R7, 2
    JMP BIT_EXTRACT

BITS_DONE:
    ; R4 = number of bits stored
    ; Now process from MSB (index R4-1) down to 0
    ; Initialize: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

    ; Start from MSB: index = R4-1
    DEC R4

DOUBLING_LOOP:
    ; Load bit at mem[R4]
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = current bit

    ; Doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    ; new a = c, new b = d

    ; Compute 2*b - a
    MOV R6, R2
    MUL R6, 2
    SUB R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3

    ; c = a * (2b - a) mod MOD
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R6
    MOD R7, R3         ; R7 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MUL R1, R2
    MOD R1, R3
    ADD R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3         ; R6 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; Now a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R7
    MOV R2, R6

    ; If bit == 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = R2 (already), fib(2k+2) = R1 + R2
    JZ R5, NO_ADVANCE
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

NO_ADVANCE:
    ; Next bit
    JZ R4, LOOP_END
    DEC R4
    JMP DOUBLING_LOOP

LOOP_END:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n\u00b2)', 'O(n\u00b2)', 'large', 'r.source:
; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7 using explicit recursion simulation with a memory stack
; Mimics: fib(n) = fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) with memoization in mem[n]
; Stack frames stored in mem[1000+] to avoid collision with memo table
; mem[0..999] = memo table (0 = not computed, except fib(0)=0 is special)
; mem[500] = sentinel: 1 means mem[0] initialized
; We use an explicit stack to simulate recursion:
;   push (n, return_addr) onto stack, process iteratively
;
; Actually: use memoized iterative DFS via explicit stack
; Stack grows from mem[2000] upward
; Each frame: mem[SP] = n to compute, mem[SP+1] = phase (0=first visit,1=return)
;
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = modulus = 1000000007
; R2 = stack pointer (index into mem)
; R3 = temp
; R4 = temp
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Initialize memo table: use mem[1000] as "fib(0) stored" flag
    ; We'll store fib values in mem[i] for i=0..n
    ; Problem: mem[0]=0 by default, same as fib(0)=0, ambiguous
    ; Solution: store fib(i)+1 in memo, 0 means not computed
    ; So memo[i] = fib(i)+1 if computed, 0 if not

    ; Initialize SP at 2000
    MOV R2, 2000

    ; Push initial call: compute fib(R0)
    ; Frame: [n, phase]
    STOR R0, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, 0
    STOR R3, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2

MAIN_LOOP:
    ; If stack empty (SP == 2000), we're done
    MOV R3, 2000
    JLE R2, R3, STACK_EMPTY

    ; Peek top frame: SP-2 = n, SP-1 = phase
    MOV R4, R2
    SUB R4, 2
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = n for this frame
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]    ; R6 = phase

    ; Check if already memoized
    LOAD R7, [R5+0]    ; R7 = memo[n]
    JNZ R7, MEMOIZED

    ; Not memoized
    ; Base case n=0: fib(0)=0, memo=1
    JZ R5, BASE_ZERO_FRAME

    ; Base case n=1: fib(1)=1, memo=2
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R5, R3, BASE_ONE_FRAME

    ; n >= 2, check phase
    JNZ R6, PHASE_ONE

    ; Phase 0: first visit
    ; Set phase=1 in current frame
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    ; Push call for fib(n-1)
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

PHASE_ONE:
    ; fib(n-1) should be computed now, push fib(n-2)
    ; Check if fib(n-2) is computed
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    JNZ R7, BOTH_READY

    ; Need to compute fib(n-2): push it
    ; Set phase=2 in current frame
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BOTH_READY:
    ; Both fib(n-1) and fib(n-2) are memoized
    ; fib(n) = (memo[n-1]-1) + (memo[n-2]-1) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    LOAD R6, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-1]
    SUB R6, 1          ; fib(n-1)

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    SUB R7, 1          ; fib(n-2)

    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1         ; fib(n)

    ; Store memo[n] = fib(n)+1
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 1
    STOR R7, [R5+0]

    ; Pop this frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

MEMOIZED:
    ; memo[n] = R7, fib(n) = R7-1
    ; Pop frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ZERO_FRAME:
    ; fib(0) = 0, memo[0] = 1
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ONE_FRAME:
    ; fib(1) = 1, memo[1] = 2
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

STACK_EMPTY:
    ; Result is memo[R0] - 1
    LOAD R3, [R0+0]
    SUB R3, 1
    OUT R3
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(1)', 'medium', 'r0-r7').source:
; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, iterative, MSB-first using a bitmask
; that starts at highest power-of-2 <= n and shifts right each step.
; No memory used, no bit stack - just a bitmask register.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = bitmask (starts at highest power of 2 <= n, shifts right)
; R5,R6,R7 = temporaries

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Find highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Start mask at 1, double while mask*2 <= n
    MOV R4, 1

FIND_MSB:
    MOV R5, R4
    MUL R5, 2
    JGT R5, R0, MSB_FOUND
    MOV R4, R5
    JMP FIND_MSB

MSB_FOUND:
    ; R4 = highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Initialize a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Fast doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD  => fib(2k)
    ; d = a^2 + b^2 mod MOD   => fib(2k+1)

    ; Compute 2*b - a, store in R5
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, 2
    SUB R5, R1
    MOD R5, R3

    ; c = a * R5 mod MOD => R6
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R5
    MOD R6, R3

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD => R7
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R1
    MOD R7, R3
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    ADD R7, R5
    MOD R7, R3

    ; a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R6
    MOV R2, R7

    ; Check if current bit of n (via mask R4) is set
    ; bit set if (n AND mask) != 0, i.e., n >= mask AND (n - mask) < mask*2... 
    ; simpler: use MOD and DIV: bit = (n / mask) % 2
    MOV R5, R0
    DIV R5, R4
    MOD R5, 2
    JZ R5, BIT_ZERO

    ; Bit is 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = b (already), fib(2k+2) = a+b
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

BIT_ZERO:
    ; Shift mask right by 1 (divide by 2)
    DIV R4, 2
    JZ R4, DONE
    JMP DOUBLE_LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(log n)', 'large', 'r0-r7.source:
; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, LSB-first bit processing.
; We extract bits of n from LSB to MSB into a memory array,
; then process MSB-to-LSB using those stored bits.
; Structurally distinct: bit extraction separate from doubling,
; bits stored in memory high-to-low, processed with a second pointer scan.
;
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = bit extraction working copy of n
; R3 = write pointer for bit array (grows upward from mem[100])
; R4 = read pointer (scans downward from top)
; R5, R6, R7 = temporaries
; R1 = a = fib(k) during doubling phase (reused)
; After bit extraction: R1=modulus saved in mem[99]

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Save modulus in mem[99]
    STOR R1, [R1-999999908]  ; can't do this easily, use R3
    MOV R3, 99
    STOR R1, [R3+0]          ; mem[99] = modulus

    ; Extract bits of n, LSB first, store in mem[100], mem[101], ...
    MOV R2, R0               ; working copy
    MOV R3, 100              ; write pointer

EXTRACT:
    JZ R2, EXTRACT_DONE
    MOV R5, R2
    MOD R5, 2                ; LSB
    STOR R5, [R3+0]          ; store bit
    INC R3
    DIV R2, 2
    JMP EXTRACT

EXTRACT_DONE:
    ; R3 now points one past last bit written
    ; Bits are in mem[100..R3-1], LSB at mem[100], MSB at mem[R3-1]
    ; Process MSB first: start read pointer at R3-1, go down to 100

    ; Initialize fast doubling: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    ; Store in mem[97]=a, mem[98]=b
    MOV R4, 97
    MOV R5, 0
    STOR R5, [R4+0]          ; mem[97] = a = 0
    MOV R5, 1
    STOR R5, [R4+1]          ; mem[98] = b = 1

    ; Read pointer starts at MSB = mem[R3-1]
    DEC R3                   ; R3 = index of MSB bit

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Load a from mem[97], b from mem[98]
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]          ; R5 = a
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]          ; R6 = b
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; R1 = modulus from mem[99]

    ; Fast doubling:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD

    MOV R7, R6
    MUL R7, 2
    SUB R7, R5
    MOD R7, R1               ; R7 = 2b - a

    ; c = a * (2b-a) mod MOD
    MUL R5, R7
    MOD R5, R1               ; R5 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b: reload a and b
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]          ; R6 = a (original)
    LOAD R7, [R4+1]          ; R7 = b (original)
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; modulus

    MUL R6, R6
    MOD R6, R1
    MUL R7, R7
    MOD R7, R1
    ADD R6, R7

; Fibonacci using a "two-steps-at-a-time" loop structure
; with a different register layout than previous solutions.
; R0 = n (input)
; R6 = modulus = 10^9+7
; We keep three consecutive fib values: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
; and advance by 2 each iteration, handling odd/even n separately.

    IN R0
    MOV R6, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, BASE_ZERO

    MOV R4, 1
    JLE R0, R4, BASE_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, f(2)=1
    ; R1 = f(k-1), R2 = f(k), R3 = f(k+1)
    ; Start at k=1: R1=f(0)=0, R2=f(1)=1, R3=f(2)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1

    ; R5 = remaining steps from index 1 to n (we need n-1 more steps)
    ; We'll track current index in R4, start at 2 (we've computed up to f(2))
    MOV R4, 2

LOOP2:
    ; If R4 >= R0, we're done
    JGE R4, R0, DONE

    ; Advance by 2: compute f(k+2) and f(k+3) from f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)
    ; But first check if one more step suffices
    MOV R5, R4
    ADD R5, 1
    JGE R5, R0, ONE_MORE

    ; Two steps:
    ; f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1)  -- R3 already is f(k+1), R2=f(k-1)... wait
    ; Let me restate: after each iteration, R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1)
    ; Step 1: new values: f(k), f(k+1), f(k+2)=f(k)+f(k+1)
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R6
    ; Now R1=f(k-1)->discard, R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R7=f(k+2)
    ; Step 2: f(k+1), f(k+2), f(k+3)=f(k+1)+f(k+2)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R7
    MOD R1, R6
    ; Shift: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)... wait need to reassign
    ; R_new1 = R3 (f(k+1)), R_new2 = R7 (f(k+2)), R_new3 = R1 (f(k+3))
    ; Use temp: R1 currently holds f(k+3)
    ; We need: R1=f(k+1), R2=f(k+2), R3=f(k+3)
    MOV R5, R1      ; R5 = f(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3      ; R1 = f(k+1)
    MOV R2, R7      ; R2 = f(k+2)
    MOV R3, R5      ; R3 = f(k+3)
    ADD R4, 2
    JMP LOOP2

ONE_MORE:
    ; One step: compute f(k+2) = f(k) + f(k+1) -- but R3=f(k+1), R2=f(k)
    ; Actually current state: R1=f(k-1), R2=f(k), R3=f(k+1), R4=k+1
    ; We need f(R4+1) = f(k+1) + f(k+2)? No.
    ; Current index is R4 meaning we have f(R4) = R3
    ; We need f(R4+1) = R2 + R3... wait
    ; R4 is the index of R3. So f(R4) = R3, f(R4-1) = R2.
    ; f(R4+1) = R2 + R3
    MOV R5, R2
    ADD R5, R3
    MOD R5, R6
    OUT R5
    HALT

DONE:
    ; R4 == R0, answer is R3 = f(R4) = f(n)
    OUT R3
    HALT

BASE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

BASE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R6, 1000000007  ; modulus

    ; Store fib values in memory: mem[i] = fib(i)
    ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R1, 0
    STOR R1, [R1+0]     ; mem[0] = 0

    ; If n == 0, done
    JZ R0, OUTPUT

    ; mem[1] = 1
    MOV R2, 1
    STOR R2, [R2+0]     ; mem[1] = 1

    ; If n == 1, done
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R0, R3, OUTPUT

    ; Fill mem[2..n] using mem[i] = mem[i-1] + mem[i-2]
    ; R4 = current index i, starts at 2
    MOV R4, 2

FILL:
    JGT R4, R0, OUTPUT  ; if i > n, stop

    ; Load mem[i-1] and mem[i-2]
    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 1
    LOAD R2, [R5+0]     ; R2 = mem[i-1]

    MOV R5, R4
    SUB R5, 2
    LOAD R1, [R5+0]     ; R1 = mem[i-2]

    ; Compute fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R6

    ; Store mem[i] = R3
    STOR R3, [R4+0]

    INC R4
    JMP FILL

OUTPUT:
    ; Load mem[n] and output
    LOAD R5, [R0+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

; Fibonacci using a "count-up with a single accumulator swap" approach
; but structured as a DO-WHILE with the loop test at the bottom,
; and using a third register to hold the modulus constant,
; advancing from fib(1),fib(2) toward fib(n).
;
; R0 = n
; R1 = fib(prev) = fib(i-1)
; R2 = fib(curr) = fib(i)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = loop counter i (starts at 2, goes up to n)
; R5 = temp for new fib value

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    ; fib(0) = 0
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    ; fib(1) = 1
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, EMIT_ONE

    ; n >= 2: initialize
    ; R1 = fib(0) = 0, R2 = fib(1) = 1, counter i = 2
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R4, 2

ITER:
    ; R5 = fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2) mod MOD
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3

    ; Advance: R1 = R2, R2 = R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

    ; i++
    INC R4

    ; if i <= n, keep going
    JLE R4, R0, ITER

    ; done: answer is R2 = fib(n)
    OUT R2
    HALT

EMIT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

EMIT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci: compute fib(n) mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: unroll loop by 4 - process 4 steps per iteration
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = fib(k)   (current)
; R2 = fib(k+1)
; R3 = fib(k+2)
; R4 = fib(k+3)
; R5 = modulus
; R6 = index tracker (how many fibs computed beyond fib(1))
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R5, 1000000007

    JZ R0, DONE_ZERO

    MOV R7, 1
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE

    MOV R7, 2
    JLE R0, R7, DONE_ONE   ; fib(2) = 1

    ; n >= 3
    ; Start with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1, fib(3)=2
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R7, R2
    ADD R7, R3
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R4, R7             ; R4 = fib(3) = 2

    ; R6 = current highest index computed = 3
    MOV R6, 3

    ; Check if n <= 3
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT

LOOP4:
    ; We have fib(k), fib(k+1), fib(k+2), fib(k+3) in R1,R2,R3,R4
    ; Check if we can do 4 more steps (need index+4 <= n)
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 4
    JGT R7, R0, REMAINDER

    ; Step 1: fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R1, R3
    ADD R1, R4
    MOD R1, R5

    ; Step 2: fib(k+5) = fib(k+3) + fib(k+4)
    MOV R2, R4
    ADD R2, R1
    MOD R2, R5

    ; Step 3: fib(k+6) = fib(k+4) + fib(k+5)
    MOV R3, R1
    ADD R3, R2
    MOD R3, R5

    ; Step 4: fib(k+7) = fib(k+5) + fib(k+6)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, R3
    MOD R4, R5

    ADD R6, 4
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    JMP LOOP4

REMAINDER:
    ; Do one step at a time until R6 == n
    ; Current state: R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; R6 = k+3

STEP1:
    JLE R0, R6, PICK_RESULT
    ; fib(k+4) = fib(k+2) + fib(k+3)
    MOV R7, R3
    ADD R7, R4
    MOD R7, R5
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R3
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R7
    INC R6
    JMP STEP1

PICK_RESULT:
    ; R6 = highest index, R0 = n
    ; R1=fib(k), R2=fib(k+1), R3=fib(k+2), R4=fib(k+3)
    ; where k = R6-3
    ; Determine which register holds fib(n)
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, 3
    ; if n == R7 => fib(n) = R1
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    ; R7 = R6 - n: 0=>R4, 1=>R3, 2=>R2, 3=>R1
    JZ R7, OUT_R4
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 1
    JZ R7, OUT_R3
    MOV R7, R6
    SUB R7, R0
    SUB R7, 2
    JZ R7, OUT_R2
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_R4:
    OUT R4
    HALT

OUT_R3:
    OUT R3
    HALT

OUT_R2:
    OUT R2
    HALT

DONE_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

DONE_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci using a countdown loop (n down to 0) with swapped register roles
; Fundamentally different: counts DOWN from n to 0, uses MOV+ADD in reverse order
; R0 = n (input), counts down to 0
; R1 = "future" fib value (starts as fib(n) conceptually built up)
; R2 = modulus
; R3 = a = fib(0) = 0
; R4 = b = fib(1) = 1
; We iterate n times: each step computes next fib, decrement counter

    IN R0
    MOV R2, 1000000007

    ; Special case n=0
    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO

    ; Special case n=1
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; General: n >= 2
    ; We'll count down: R0 goes from n to 1
    ; R3 = fib(i-1), R4 = fib(i), compute fib(i+1) = R3+R4
    ; Start: R3=fib(0)=0, R4=fib(1)=1, counter=n-1 steps needed
    MOV R3, 0
    MOV R4, 1
    ; We need n-1 more steps to get fib(n)
    DEC R0   ; R0 = n-1

COUNTDOWN:
    ; R5 = fib(i+1) = R3 + R4 mod MOD
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R2

    ; Shift: R3 = R4, R4 = R5
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5

    DEC R0
    JNZ R0, COUNTDOWN

    ; R4 = fib(n)
    OUT R4
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci using matrix exponentiation (iterative doubling method)
; fib(2k)   = fib(k) * (2*fib(k+1) - fib(k))
; fib(2k+1) = fib(k)^2 + fib(k+1)^2
; This is O(log n) time, fundamentally different from all iterative O(n) solutions above.
;
; We store the "stack" of bits of n in memory, then process from MSB to LSB.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = temp / bit storage pointer
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Store bits of n (LSB first) in mem[0], mem[1], ...
    ; We'll read them back MSB first
    MOV R4, 0          ; bit count / index
    MOV R7, R0         ; working copy of n

BIT_EXTRACT:
    JZ R7, BITS_DONE
    ; bit = R7 % 2
    MOV R5, R7
    MOD R5, 2
    STOR R5, [R4+0]    ; store bit
    INC R4
    DIV R7, 2
    JMP BIT_EXTRACT

BITS_DONE:
    ; R4 = number of bits stored
    ; Now process from MSB (index R4-1) down to 0
    ; Initialize: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

    ; Start from MSB: index = R4-1
    DEC R4

DOUBLING_LOOP:
    ; Load bit at mem[R4]
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = current bit

    ; Doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    ; new a = c, new b = d

    ; Compute 2*b - a
    MOV R6, R2
    MUL R6, 2
    SUB R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3

    ; c = a * (2b - a) mod MOD
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R6
    MOD R7, R3         ; R7 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MUL R1, R2
    MOD R1, R3
    ADD R6, R1
    MOD R6, R3         ; R6 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; Now a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R7
    MOV R2, R6

    ; If bit == 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = R2 (already), fib(2k+2) = R1 + R2
    JZ R5, NO_ADVANCE
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

NO_ADVANCE:
    ; Next bit
    JZ R4, LOOP_END
    DEC R4
    JMP DOUBLING_LOOP

LOOP_END:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7 using a circular buffer of size 3 in memory
; mem[0], mem[1], mem[2] hold three consecutive fib values
; A write pointer cycles 0->1->2->0->...
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = write pointer (0,1,2)
; R3 = loop counter
; R4 = temp: index of oldest value (write+0 mod 3 after write)
; R5, R6 = temps

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Handle n=0
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    ; Handle n=1 or n=2
    MOV R5, 2
    JLE R0, R5, EMIT_ONE

    ; Initialize circular buffer:
    ; mem[0] = fib(0) = 0
    ; mem[1] = fib(1) = 1
    ; mem[2] = fib(2) = 1
    MOV R5, 0
    STOR R5, [R5+0]     ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R5, 1
    STOR R5, [R5+0]     ; mem[1] = 1
    STOR R5, [R5+1]     ; mem[2] = 1

    ; R2 = write pointer: next slot to overwrite = 0 (holds fib(0), oldest)
    ; After writing fib(3), pointer advances to 1, etc.
    ; Current state: buf has fib(0),fib(1),fib(2), pointer=0 (fib(0) is oldest)
    ; We've computed up to index 2. Need to reach index n.
    ; R3 = current highest index in buffer = 2
    MOV R3, 2
    MOV R2, 0           ; write pointer (slot to overwrite next)

LOOP:
    ; If R3 >= R0, we have fib(n) in buffer
    JGE R3, R0, FIND_RESULT

    ; Compute fib(R3+1) = fib(R3) + fib(R3-1)
    ; The two newest values are at slots (R2+2)%3 and (R2+1)%3
    ; (R2+1)%3 = second newest = fib(R3-1)
    ; (R2+2)%3 = newest = fib(R3)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, 2
    MOD R4, 3
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]     ; R5 = fib(R3) (newest)

    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, 1
    MOD R4, 3
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]     ; R6 = fib(R3-1) (second newest)

    ADD R5, R6
    MOD R5, R1          ; R5 = fib(R3+1)

    ; Write into slot R2 (oldest), overwriting fib(R3-2)
    STOR R5, [R2+0]

    ; Advance write pointer
    INC R2
    MOD R2, 3

    INC R3
    JMP LOOP

FIND_RESULT:
    ; R3 = n (or >= n, but we stop exactly at n)
    ; fib(n) is in slot (R2+2)%3 (the newest written slot)
    MOV R4, R2
    ADD R4, 2
    MOD R4, 3
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

EMIT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

EMIT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: "ping-pong" between two memory locations
; mem[0] and mem[1] alternate as "current" and "next"
; We use a phase bit to know which slot holds fib(i)
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = phase (0 or 1): mem[phase] = fib(i), mem[1-phase] = fib(i-1)
; R3 = counter (current index i)
; R4, R5, R6 = temps

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; n=0 => 0
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    ; n=1 => 1
    MOV R4, 1
    JLE R0, R4, EMIT_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize: mem[0]=fib(0)=0, mem[1]=fib(1)=1
    ; phase=1 means mem[1]=fib(1) is current, mem[0]=fib(0) is previous
    MOV R4, 0
    STOR R4, [R4+0]    ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R4, 1
    STOR R4, [R4+0]    ; mem[1] = 1

    MOV R2, 1          ; phase = 1 (current fib is in mem[1])
    MOV R3, 1          ; current index = 1

PINGPONG:
    ; If current index == n, output mem[phase]
    JGE R3, R0, OUTPUT_PHASE

    ; next_phase = 1 - phase
    MOV R5, 1
    SUB R5, R2         ; R5 = next_phase = 1 - phase

    ; Load fib(i) from mem[phase]
    LOAD R4, [R2+0]    ; R4 = fib(i)

    ; Load fib(i-1) from mem[next_phase]
    LOAD R6, [R5+0]    ; R6 = fib(i-1)

    ; fib(i+1) = fib(i) + fib(i-1) mod MOD
    ADD R4, R6
    MOD R4, R1

    ; Store fib(i+1) into mem[next_phase] (overwrite old fib(i-1))
    STOR R4, [R5+0]

    ; Advance phase to next_phase
    MOV R2, R5

    INC R3
    JMP PINGPONG

OUTPUT_PHASE:
    LOAD R5, [R2+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

EMIT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

EMIT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7 using explicit recursion simulation with a memory stack
; Mimics: fib(n) = fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) with memoization in mem[n]
; Stack frames stored in mem[1000+] to avoid collision with memo table
; mem[0..999] = memo table (0 = not computed, except fib(0)=0 is special)
; mem[500] = sentinel: 1 means mem[0] initialized
; We use an explicit stack to simulate recursion:
;   push (n, return_addr) onto stack, process iteratively
;
; Actually: use memoized iterative DFS via explicit stack
; Stack grows from mem[2000] upward
; Each frame: mem[SP] = n to compute, mem[SP+1] = phase (0=first visit,1=return)
;
; R0 = n (input)
; R1 = modulus = 1000000007
; R2 = stack pointer (index into mem)
; R3 = temp
; R4 = temp
; R5 = temp
; R6 = temp
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Initialize memo table: use mem[1000] as "fib(0) stored" flag
    ; We'll store fib values in mem[i] for i=0..n
    ; Problem: mem[0]=0 by default, same as fib(0)=0, ambiguous
    ; Solution: store fib(i)+1 in memo, 0 means not computed
    ; So memo[i] = fib(i)+1 if computed, 0 if not

    ; Initialize SP at 2000
    MOV R2, 2000

    ; Push initial call: compute fib(R0)
    ; Frame: [n, phase]
    STOR R0, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, 0
    STOR R3, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2

MAIN_LOOP:
    ; If stack empty (SP == 2000), we're done
    MOV R3, 2000
    JLE R2, R3, STACK_EMPTY

    ; Peek top frame: SP-2 = n, SP-1 = phase
    MOV R4, R2
    SUB R4, 2
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]    ; R5 = n for this frame
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]    ; R6 = phase

    ; Check if already memoized
    LOAD R7, [R5+0]    ; R7 = memo[n]
    JNZ R7, MEMOIZED

    ; Not memoized
    ; Base case n=0: fib(0)=0, memo=1
    JZ R5, BASE_ZERO_FRAME

    ; Base case n=1: fib(1)=1, memo=2
    MOV R3, 1
    JLE R5, R3, BASE_ONE_FRAME

    ; n >= 2, check phase
    JNZ R6, PHASE_ONE

    ; Phase 0: first visit
    ; Set phase=1 in current frame
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    ; Push call for fib(n-1)
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

PHASE_ONE:
    ; fib(n-1) should be computed now, push fib(n-2)
    ; Check if fib(n-2) is computed
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    JNZ R7, BOTH_READY

    ; Need to compute fib(n-2): push it
    ; Set phase=2 in current frame
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R4+1]

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R2+0]
    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R2+1]
    ADD R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BOTH_READY:
    ; Both fib(n-1) and fib(n-2) are memoized
    ; fib(n) = (memo[n-1]-1) + (memo[n-2]-1) mod MOD
    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 1
    LOAD R6, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-1]
    SUB R6, 1          ; fib(n-1)

    MOV R3, R5
    SUB R3, 2
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]    ; memo[n-2]
    SUB R7, 1          ; fib(n-2)

    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1         ; fib(n)

    ; Store memo[n] = fib(n)+1
    MOV R7, R6
    ADD R7, 1
    STOR R7, [R5+0]

    ; Pop this frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

MEMOIZED:
    ; memo[n] = R7, fib(n) = R7-1
    ; Pop frame
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ZERO_FRAME:
    ; fib(0) = 0, memo[0] = 1
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

BASE_ONE_FRAME:
    ; fib(1) = 1, memo[1] = 2
    MOV R3, 2
    STOR R3, [R5+0]
    SUB R2, 2
    JMP MAIN_LOOP

STACK_EMPTY:
    ; Result is memo[R0] - 1
    LOAD R3, [R0+0]
    SUB R3, 1
    OUT R3
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, iterative, MSB-first using a bitmask
; that starts at highest power-of-2 <= n and shifts right each step.
; No memory used, no bit stack - just a bitmask register.
; R0 = n
; R1 = a = fib(k)
; R2 = b = fib(k+1)
; R3 = modulus
; R4 = bitmask (starts at highest power of 2 <= n, shifts right)
; R5,R6,R7 = temporaries

    IN R0
    MOV R3, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Find highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Start mask at 1, double while mask*2 <= n
    MOV R4, 1

FIND_MSB:
    MOV R5, R4
    MUL R5, 2
    JGT R5, R0, MSB_FOUND
    MOV R4, R5
    JMP FIND_MSB

MSB_FOUND:
    ; R4 = highest power of 2 <= n
    ; Initialize a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Fast doubling step:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD  => fib(2k)
    ; d = a^2 + b^2 mod MOD   => fib(2k+1)

    ; Compute 2*b - a, store in R5
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, 2
    SUB R5, R1
    MOD R5, R3

    ; c = a * R5 mod MOD => R6
    MOV R6, R1
    MUL R6, R5
    MOD R6, R3

    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD => R7
    MOV R7, R1
    MUL R7, R1
    MOD R7, R3
    MOV R5, R2
    MUL R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    ADD R7, R5
    MOD R7, R3

    ; a = c, b = d
    MOV R1, R6
    MOV R2, R7

    ; Check if current bit of n (via mask R4) is set
    ; bit set if (n AND mask) != 0, i.e., n >= mask AND (n - mask) < mask*2... 
    ; simpler: use MOD and DIV: bit = (n / mask) % 2
    MOV R5, R0
    DIV R5, R4
    MOD R5, 2
    JZ R5, BIT_ZERO

    ; Bit is 1: advance one step
    ; fib(2k+1) = b (already), fib(2k+2) = a+b
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R3
    MOV R1, R2
    MOV R2, R5

BIT_ZERO:
    ; Shift mask right by 1 (divide by 2)
    DIV R4, 2
    JZ R4, DONE
    JMP DOUBLE_LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: Fast doubling, LSB-first bit processing.
; We extract bits of n from LSB to MSB into a memory array,
; then process MSB-to-LSB using those stored bits.
; Structurally distinct: bit extraction separate from doubling,
; bits stored in memory high-to-low, processed with a second pointer scan.
;
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = bit extraction working copy of n
; R3 = write pointer for bit array (grows upward from mem[100])
; R4 = read pointer (scans downward from top)
; R5, R6, R7 = temporaries
; R1 = a = fib(k) during doubling phase (reused)
; After bit extraction: R1=modulus saved in mem[99]

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    JZ R0, OUT_ZERO
    MOV R5, 1
    JLE R0, R5, OUT_ONE

    ; Save modulus in mem[99]
    STOR R1, [R1-999999908]  ; can't do this easily, use R3
    MOV R3, 99
    STOR R1, [R3+0]          ; mem[99] = modulus

    ; Extract bits of n, LSB first, store in mem[100], mem[101], ...
    MOV R2, R0               ; working copy
    MOV R3, 100              ; write pointer

EXTRACT:
    JZ R2, EXTRACT_DONE
    MOV R5, R2
    MOD R5, 2                ; LSB
    STOR R5, [R3+0]          ; store bit
    INC R3
    DIV R2, 2
    JMP EXTRACT

EXTRACT_DONE:
    ; R3 now points one past last bit written
    ; Bits are in mem[100..R3-1], LSB at mem[100], MSB at mem[R3-1]
    ; Process MSB first: start read pointer at R3-1, go down to 100

    ; Initialize fast doubling: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    ; Store in mem[97]=a, mem[98]=b
    MOV R4, 97
    MOV R5, 0
    STOR R5, [R4+0]          ; mem[97] = a = 0
    MOV R5, 1
    STOR R5, [R4+1]          ; mem[98] = b = 1

    ; Read pointer starts at MSB = mem[R3-1]
    DEC R3                   ; R3 = index of MSB bit

DOUBLE_LOOP:
    ; Load a from mem[97], b from mem[98]
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]          ; R5 = a
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]          ; R6 = b
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; R1 = modulus from mem[99]

    ; Fast doubling:
    ; c = a*(2b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD

    MOV R7, R6
    MUL R7, 2
    SUB R7, R5
    MOD R7, R1               ; R7 = 2b - a

    ; c = a * (2b-a) mod MOD
    MUL R5, R7
    MOD R5, R1               ; R5 = c = fib(2k)

    ; d = a*a + b*b: reload a and b
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]          ; R6 = a (original)
    LOAD R7, [R4+1]          ; R7 = b (original)
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; modulus

    MUL R6, R6
    MOD R6, R1
    MUL R7, R7
    MOD R7, R1
    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1               ; R6 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; Store new a=c, b=d
    MOV R4, 97
    STOR R5, [R4+0]
    STOR R6, [R4+1]

    ; Check current bit at mem[R3]
    LOAD R7, [R3+0]
    JZ R7, BIT_IS_ZERO

    ; Bit=1: advance: new_a=d, new_b=c+d
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]          ; a=c
    LOAD R6, [R4+1]          ; b=d
    LOAD R1, [R4+2]          ; modulus
    MOV R7, R5
    ADD R7, R6
    MOD R7, R1               ; c+d
    STOR R6, [R4+0]          ; new a = d
    STOR R7, [R4+1]          ; new b = c+d

BIT_IS_ZERO:
    ; Move read pointer toward LSB
    DEC R3
    ; If R3 < 100, done
    MOV R7, 100
    JLT R3, R7, FINISH
    JMP DOUBLE_LOOP

FINISH:
    ; Result is a = mem[97]
    MOV R4, 97
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

OUT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci mod 10^9+7
; Algorithm: table-fill with 8x manual unrolling per chunk
; Fill mem[0..n] with fib values, then output mem[n]
; Unrolled inner body: each chunk computes 8 consecutive fib values
; R0 = n
; R1 = modulus
; R2 = current index i (starts at 2)
; R3 = fib(i-2)
; R4 = fib(i-1)
; R5 = fib(i) temp
; R6 = chunk end index
; R7 = temp

    IN R0
    MOV R1, 1000000007

    ; Base: mem[0]=0 already, mem[1]=1
    JZ R0, EMIT_ZERO

    MOV R7, 0
    STOR R7, [R7+0]       ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R7, 1
    STOR R7, [R7+0]       ; mem[1] = 1

    MOV R7, 1
    JLE R0, R7, EMIT_ONE

    ; n >= 2
    ; Initialize R3=fib(0)=0, R4=fib(1)=1, i=2
    MOV R3, 0
    MOV R4, 1
    MOV R2, 2

CHUNK_START:
    ; If i > n, done filling
    JGT R2, R0, DONE_FILL

    ; Compute chunk end = min(i+7, n), store in R6
    MOV R6, R2
    ADD R6, 7
    JLE R6, R0, DO_CHUNK
    MOV R6, R0            ; clamp to n

DO_CHUNK:
    ; We'll do up to 8 steps manually, checking i<=R6 each time

    ; Step 1
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 2
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 3
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 4
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 5
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 6
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 7
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    ; Step 8
    JGT R2, R6, CHUNK_START
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4
    MOD R5, R1
    STOR R5, [R2+0]
    MOV R3, R4
    MOV R4, R5
    INC R2

    JMP CHUNK_START

DONE_FILL:
    ; Output mem[n]
    LOAD R5, [R0+0]
    OUT R5
    HALT

EMIT_ZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

EMIT_ONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT
